args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Identified the bad release**: Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only staging); the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — completed and verified.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback.
4. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with an error rate of 0.2%.
